video_title: Re-Drafting The 2023 NBA Draft: WILD Draft Climbers

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Goodwill selects Victor Wembanyama first overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: I am going to of course San Antonio I'm going to take Victor Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Goodwill
text_blocks.text: This is a really difficult decision because you got both Thompson twins to pick between. But I am going to of course San Antonio I'm going to take Victor Wembanyama. Very easy choice. I would say out of the last what 10 number one picks, he's probably the easiest or maybe 20 since LeBron James.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I mean I would say he's up there with LeBron. I remember Woj created a little bit of a ripple when he said he might be the best prospect ever leading up to that draft.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects Amen Thompson second overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: I am going with Amen Thompson, even though Ausar has come on extraordinarily strong.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I am going with Amen Thompson, even though Ausar has come on extraordinarily strong. They are both having terrific careers and I don't even really I just I've seen I've watched Amen play a little bit more. He's got a little bit more of a history and his defensive intensity. Although Ausar was the one who made all defense this year.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon discusses the impact of Ime Udoka on Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: Big hire for the Houston Rockets hiring Ime Udoka and obviously Amen is going to be his new pet project.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Big hire for the Houston Rockets hiring Ime Udoka and obviously Amen is going to be his new pet project, as Lou Dort was, as Kawhi Leonard was before that and among others.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Goodwill
text_blocks.text: Those are the best two athletes in the league.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Brandon Miller third overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: Number three pick is going to be Brandon Miller, and remember there are a lot of eyebrows raised when Charlotte took Brandon Miller over Scoot Henderson.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Number three pick is going to be Brandon Miller, and remember there are a lot of eyebrows raised when Charlotte took Brandon Miller over Scoot Henderson and clearly that decision is ended up being the right decision.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Goodwill
text_blocks.text: Yes I can. Where to get that snake draft right.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon

quotes.excerpt: I am going to take Cason Wallace over Ausar Thompson.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I am going to take Cason Wallace over Ausar Thompson. And the reason I'm going to do that, one Cason Wallace also was an all defensive player last year.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Cason Wallace taken 10th by the Thunder.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Technically taken by the Mavs and there was a trade down. The Mavs dumped Davis Bertans contract.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects Ausar Thompson fifth overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: Ausar Thompson was the fifth overall pick to Detroit. I really the way that he competed against Jalen Brunson in the 2025 playoffs.
quotes.quote: Ausar Thompson was the fifth overall pick to Detroit. I really the way that he competed against Jalen Brunson in the 2025 playoffs is where Ausar really sort of put his foot forward. Led the league in steals per game this year.

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Goodwill selects Keyonte George sixth overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: Keyonte George from the Utah Jazz. I know people don't pay attention to the Jazz.
quotes.quote: Keyonte George from the Utah Jazz. I know people don't pay attention to the Jazz because he was the 16th pick in that draft. That was one of the picks that they got from the Rudy Gobert trade, if I'm not mistaken.

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Goodwill selects Dereck Lively II seventh overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: I am going to take Dereck Lively II.
quotes.quote: I am going to take Dereck Lively II. It's basically to me between him, Jaime Jaquez Jr., who's you know a 3 and D traditional 3 and D guy. I'm hoping in this pick that the foot problems are behind him because I'm a huge believer in the upside.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects Toumani Camara eighth overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: I am going to go with Toumani Camara here.
quotes.quote: I am going to go with Toumani Camara here. And that is the guy other than Wembanyama who's already had an extension in this class. He was the 52nd pick in the draft by the Suns and was in the in the trade for the Deandre Ayton trade. And the Dame trade. I'm sorry in a Dame trade.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Scoot Henderson ninth overall in the redraft
quotes.quote: I'll take Scoot here. He was number three. I mean again people were surprised he didn't go second. He showed some real flashes in their playoff series last year. I honestly I just I ask what guard's not starting and I mentioned Drew Holiday. Obviously there's Dame, there's Ja. I don't know where the hell Scoot fits in this whole picture.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Anthony Black tenth overall in the redraft
quotes.quote: I'll take Anthony Black. A good one that's who I was going to take. Who had a bit of a breakout season last year. Really a lot of it was just the volume went up. But as the volume went up, he maintained his efficiency and got a little bit more efficient and averaged 15 per game last year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects Jaime Jaquez Jr. eleventh overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: I am going to take Jaime Jaquez Jr. here.
quotes.quote: I am going to take Jaime Jaquez Jr. here. Just has not shot the ball well and it's kind of tough to to take a 3 and D guy with no three, but he had a really good third year. Was you know was finished fourth in the rookie of the year and for a time was like competing with Victor for rookie of the year.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Brandin Podziemski twelfth overall in the redraft
quotes.quote: I'm taking Pods. The answer is not as good as he thinks he is. That's exactly the point. The man who says I want I'm going to be better than Steph Curry. Like, the stuff that he says is more than what he plays.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Brice Sensabaugh thirteenth overall in the redraft
quotes.quote: I'll take Brice Sensabaugh here. He's proven he can score in the NBA. He hadn't had a chance to prove it can be part of a winning team. He'll get that opportunity. And you know kind of a big body, not kind of really a big body, 6'6 235, bench score, shooter. Will Hardy refers to him as the crockpot.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects Bilal Coulibaly fourteenth overall in the redraft
quotes.excerpt: We'll end it with Bilal Coulibaly.
quotes.quote: We'll end it with Bilal Coulibaly, who honestly at this point, he's still a concept of a player at this point in his career. The concept is he is a good size in terms of height, super athletic wing. You know it's it's tough man when you look at games played. Rookie year 55, second year 36, last year seven.
